newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pathe returns to profit in 1996, sets dividend.
newsitem.headline: Pathe returns to profit in 1996, sets dividend.

text.p: Pathe said it posted a net attributable profit of 186 million francs for calendar 1996, compared with a pro-forma loss of 509 million francs for 1995.
It also said in a statement on Tuesday it had set a dividend of 10 francs in respect of 1996.
Pathe was formed in June 1996 from a demerger of the media interests of Chargeurs SA. Its 1995 results were calculated on a pro-forma basis.
Turnover rose to 1.84 billion francs in 1996 from 1.09 billion in 1995.

Production and distribution of films accounted for 807 million of turnover against 508 million previously, cinema takings came to 736 million against 527 million, and television contribued 87 million compared with 58 million.
Daily newspaper Liberation, consolidated for the second half, accounted for 211 million of turnover.

Pathe said the strong rise in turnover was largely due to the contribution of acquisitions in 1996 which were not present or partially present in 1995. These included Renn Productions/AMLF, cinema takings in the Netherlands for the whole year compared with only one half of 1995 and Liberation.
